1036. Library Rack Allocation System

Problem Statement:
Create a book rack allocation system in a library, which allocates appropriate space for the books based on category using appropriate data structures.
input_spec:
The first line of the input is the integer denoting the number of available empty racks in the library which is always greater than the available book categories.

Each rack can accommodate up to 10 books and can have books only from the same category.

The next line is the integer input N denoting the number of book categories that are still needed to be stored in the library.

Followed by details of the books in each category in the following format:

< category name > < book available > < popularity >

Allocate the available racks based on the popularity of books(higher the better). But not exceeding their available stocks.
output_spec:
Print the details of the book category and the number of racks allocated as follows:

< category name > < racks allocated >
